title: 22.7. Kusalattika, Saññojanagocchakādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nakusalaṁ nosaññojanaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca akusalo saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nakusalaṁ noganthaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca akusalo gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nakusalaṁ nooghaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca akusalo ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nakusalaṁ noyogaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca akusalo yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nakusalaṁ nonīvaraṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca akusalo nīvaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nakusalaṁ noparāmāsaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca akusalo parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
